findings.description: Critical: Revision 2 adds explicit `catalog_vendor` but still does not define the configured model/endpoint membership used to join dg-00 `model_catalog` when `AgentEntry.cli.model` is null (the common case in `agents.yaml`). Catalog rows are keyed `(vendor, model, endpoint_kind)`; without naming whether join uses `sdk.model`, archetype model rosters, a new explicit model list, and/or `endpoint_kind`, list projections stay `known=false` and D4's “matching catalog model” local gate has no deterministic match set.
findings.resolution: Normatively enumerate AgentEntry/config fields that supply model IDs and endpoint_kind for catalog joins; define empty-membership behavior (unknown projection + audited miss) without heuristic publisher inference.

findings.description: Critical: D4/spec local catalog gating is keyed to “local lane”, but existing dg-00 health is `endpoint_kind=local` while planned `location=local` means CLI-host locality (`claude-local` still talks to cloud Anthropic). No current agent sets `endpoint_kind`. Applying catalog availability/staleness to all `location=local` lanes can falsely degrade healthy cloud CLI lanes when OpenRouter rows are stale, or never gate anything when no models match.
findings.resolution: Split the gate: state whether catalog health applies to `location=local`, `endpoint_kind=local`, or both with distinct rules; keep cloud CLI readiness on the vendor-health probe path.

findings.description: Critical: D7 asserts dispatch adapters already know selected `agent_id` and that `provider_dispatch.py` reports capacity with lane/reset metadata, but `PhaseDispatchPayload`/`PhaseDispatchResult` only carry `provider` (e.g. `claude_code`), and the module has no capacity/429/reset classification seam today. Putting the file in write scope closes ownership, not the missing lane/capacity contract.
findings.resolution: Require plumbing `dispatch_agent_id` (or equivalent) into provider-dispatch payload/result, define provider→lane selection when only provider exists, and specify where capacity/reset metadata is extracted before bridge POST.

findings.description: Critical: Task 3.6/D1 require packaging the reused health probe, but do not require aligning watchdog load path with the image layout. `watchdog.py` resolves `parents[2]/skills/.../vendor_health.py` from `/app/src` to `/skills/...`, while the image sets `SKILLS_ROOT=/app/skills` and copies skills under `/app/skills` (as with `github_classifier.py`). COPY alone can still leave the deployed probe silently skipped.
findings.resolution: Require watchdog to honor `SKILLS_ROOT` (or an equivalent portable root) and specify the Dockerfile COPY destination that makes the probe present and executable in production.

findings.description: Nit: `review_dispatcher.py` already has `agent_id` and capacity classification, but D7's “retry/reset metadata” has no source: `ReviewResult` carries `error_class` without `retry_after`/`reset_at`, and no parsing rule is specified. Exact-lane reports would always fall through to `VENDOR_UNKNOWN_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS` unless implementers invent undocumented parsers.
findings.resolution: Define which adapter/stderr/header fields may supply reset metadata, the parse/fail behavior when absent, and the result-collector fields that carry them into the bridge helper.

findings.description: Nit: D6 requires Bearer, `X-Coordinator-API-Key`, or `X-API-Key`, and runtime `verify_api_key` already accepts all three, but `contracts/openapi/v1.yaml` securitySchemes only declare Bearer and `X-API-Key`. Contract-parity tests will under-specify the third header that existing coordinator clients and other OpenAPI surfaces already use.
findings.resolution: Add an OpenAPI apiKey security scheme for `X-Coordinator-API-Key` and list it on the registry operations alongside the existing schemes.

findings.description: Nit: Storage/design require non-null probe `stale_after` and limit `reset_at`, but the event schema types both as `string|null` while marking them required by kind—so `null` still validates. OpenAPI `RateLimitObservation` also leaves both reset fields optional/nullable and does not encode the prose rule that supplying both is rejected (400).
findings.resolution: Make event `stale_after`/`reset_at` non-null when required by kind; add OpenAPI constraints or explicit 400 semantics so dual-reset payloads cannot pass contract parity as valid.

findings.description: Nit: D8 closes the quote formula, but roadmap switch evaluation still has no specified source of exact catalog model plus prompt/completion token estimates on the `vendor_limit` path (today only vendor/reason). Without that wiring, either `cost_ceiling_usd` becomes permanently inert or implementers will reintroduce vendor-scalar/`_STATIC_COST_TIERS` USD deltas contrary to D8.
findings.resolution: Specify how switch evaluation obtains model id and token estimates (or explicitly require unknown quotes and non-enforcement of USD ceilings whenever those inputs are absent).

findings.description: Nit: tasks.md 6.2 still requires mypy, migration, contract, and DAG gates, but `wp-integration` verification only runs coordinator/skills pytest, strict OpenSpec, and two Ruff checks. Migration/contract coverage lives earlier, and mypy/DAG remain non-executable relative to the task checklist.
findings.resolution: Either add mypy/DAG (and any missing migration/contract re-checks) as `wp-integration` verification steps or narrow task 6.2 to the commands the packages actually run.
